title: CAM: Make adaptive operation skip finishing passes in pre-cleared regions

target.summary: Duplicate point filtering only handles vertices where pt.z == 1, failing to deduplicate other shared vertices when open-path intersection produces multiple segments. When a path crosses in and out of the stock boundary, these duplicate points cause path reassembly to look up non-generated vertex IDs in newZNeedsFinishing, throwing a std::out_of_range exception.
notes: faulty deduplication logic that only filters vertices with z == 1
relies on nonclearedPoints being deduplicated; throws std::out_of_range in map::at on duplicate vertices
